thread:
elaine_sales: POC with LATAM supermarket starts tomorrow morning. They pinned `redwood-pegasus-3.0` but their devs report failures from sa-east-1. Need fallback + legal/SOW language asap.

sam_se: Paste the error?

elaine_sales: From their curl:
```
POST /v1/generate
{"model":"redwood-pegasus-3.0","region":"sa-east-1"}
=> 404 ModelNotFound: not deployed in region
```

priya_infra: Confirmed. pegasus-3.0 isn't replicated to sa-east-1. Options: 1) route to us-east-1 (cross-border) 2) use `redwood-pegasus-3-lite` in sa-east-1 (quant) 3) quick Dedicated in-region trial (48-72h provisioning, billing commit).

omar_security: If we route cross-border, PII may leave country. Customer asked for "no cross-border PII". Only in-region Dedicated/private satisfies that. For POC we can offer token-level redaction, in-flight pseudonymization, or a dockerized on-prem eval image of the runtime (non-PII only) for air-gap tests.

vince_solution: For fast wins, I recommend fallback to lite + explicit headers: `x-rw-model-used` and `x-rw-fallback=true`. Also add `pin_mode=strict` to allow them to reject any fallback.

sam_se: Example route config:
```
PUT /v1/route-config
{"prefer_region":"sa-east-1","pin_mode":"allow_fallback","fallbacks":["redwood-pegasus-3-lite","redwood-pegasus-2.9"]}
```

priya_infra: Pricing note: cross-region adds cloud egress (estimate $0.02-$0.08 per 1M tokens depending on provider) + extra latency (~40-120ms). Dedicated removes egress but has min commit. DM'ing numbers to Elaine.

omar_security: SQ language must mention: fallback mechanics, KMS region, retention of logs (we typically retain debug logs 30 days), and the option for an on-prem evaluation package. Any deviation needs legal sign-off.

legal_bot: Legal: Any promise of "no cross-border" requires signed SOW with in-region Dedicated/Private. We can approve temporary redaction guidance but not exceptions to residency.

elaine_sales: Customer also asked whether pinned models auto-rollforward on deprecation.

vince_solution: Behavior: pin_mode strict => fail requests with `ModelDeprecated` error. pin_mode allow_fallback => apply fallback list, we return headers and log deprecation events. We can include a clause in SOW that we will not auto-rollforward during POC timeframe unless customer authorizes.

priya_infra: infra note: replication job not scheduled for pegasus-3.0 -> Dedicated provisioning ETA 48-72h. We can publish a short-term on-prem docker test image for them to run locally (no network egress) but it has limited throughput.

elaine_sales: Action list: 1) Sam post route-config examples and client curl snippets (sam). 2) Priya send Dedicated trial pricing + on-prem docker instructions (priya). 3) Vince run 40-prompt A/B between pegasus-3.0 (us-east) and pegasus-3-lite (sa-east) and share CSV (vince). 4) Omar draft SQ blurb & loop legal (omar).

sam_se: I'll drop curl + node client toggles in 15m.

priya_infra: Pricing DM sent.

vince_solution: Eval in progress, will post results by EOD.

omar_security: Draft SQ posted, cc: @legal for sign-off.

elaine_sales: Thanks all — I'll tell customer fallback options + SOW language. :thumbsup:
